articles.title: India to Host One of the Largest Integrated Defence, Aviation, Airport Infrastructure, Aerospace & Business Platform
articles.description: India is poised to emerge as a global meeting point for the defence, aerospace, aviation and airport infrastructure industries during September 10-12, 2026 as AEDEX + AIRPORT , bring together policymakers, global technology providers, defence manufacturers, airport developers, investors and industry leaders under one roof at Yashobhoomi, India International Convention & Expo Centre (IICC), New Delhi. With India accelerating its emergence as a global aerospace, defence manufacturing and aviation powerhouse, the three-day AEDEX + AIRPORT beginning on September 10, 2026, will witness a grand convergence of leading defence organisations, aerospace manufacturers, technology innovators, policymakers, research institutions and international industry leaders at India International Convention & Expo Centre (IICC), Dwarka. AEDEX + AIRPORT - International Exhibitions and Conferences 2026 are designed to serve as a premier business and technology platform for defence manufacturers, aerospace companies, government agencies, armed forces, research organisations, technology providers, Infrastructure providers, and global investors to showcase next-generation technologies, foster strategic partnerships and explore new business opportunities across the aerospace, defence and airport ecosystem. The events are supported by the Ministries of Civil Aviation, Commerce & Industry, MSME, DRDO (Ministry of Defence), the Directorate General of Civil Aviation, CSIR, and the Make in India and Start Up India initiatives, as also Industry organisations of Aeronautical Society Of India, The Drone Federation of India and Air Cargo Forum India. India's aerospace and defence sector has been undergoing unprecedented transformation, driven by the Government's flagship initiatives such as Make in India and Atmanirbhar Bharat, which seek to promote indigenous manufacturing, technological innovation, private sector participation and export competitiveness. Supported by policy reforms, increased capital expenditure and growing international collaborations, the Indian aerospace and defence market is projected to reach USD 70 billion by 2030, creating significant opportunities for domestic and global industry participants. The recent approval of the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme marks another major milestone in India's journey towards defence self-reliance. The ambitious fifth-generation fighter aircraft project is expected to significantly enhance collaboration between the public and private sectors while accelerating indigenous research, advanced manufacturing and technology development. The initiative further reinforces India's long-term commitment to building globally competitive defence capabilities under the vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat. India's airport sector is experiencing rapid transformation and massive infrastructure expansion, solidifying its position as the World's third domestic aviation market. With the number of operational airports more than doubling since 2014, the sector is backed by the multi- million- dollar by the Government and private sector. Against this rapidly evolving landscape, AEDEX +AIRPORT 2026 will provide a timely platform for industry stakeholders to engage with India's leading defence and aviation organisations, including Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL), Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), National Aerospace Laboratories (CSIR - NAL), Kochi International Airport , DGQA (Ministry of Defence) etc while exploring collaborative opportunities with international partners. Participation is from 10 Countries (Australia, Canada, Finland, France, Germany, Norway, Singapore, South Korea, UAE, USA) to name a few. The exhibitions will showcase a comprehensive range of aerospace and defence technologies covering military aviation, defence electronics, avionics, missile systems, unmanned aerial systems (UAS), counter-UAS technologies, autonomous platforms, avionics,aerospace components, Aero Structures, precision engineering, additive manufacturing, advanced materials and composites, cyber security, artificial intelligence, robotics, digital solutions, simulation technologies, navigation systems, logistics solutions, testing and quality assurance, Airport technologies, aircraft interiors, maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO), and next-generation defence manufacturing technologies. AEDEX + AIRPORT 2026 is expected to attract participation from defence public sector undertakings, aerospace original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), private defence manufacturers, defence contractors, system integrators, MSMEs, start-ups, engineering companies, research laboratories, academic institutions, technology developers, export promotion agencies, financial institutions and international country pavilions representing major global aerospace and defence markets. The events will also draw senior representatives from defence ministries, armed forces, homeland security organisations, defence procurement and acquisition agencies, public sector enterprises, international delegations, defence attachés, trade missions, procurement specialists, supply chain professionals, space and geospatial organisations, naval and maritime security companies, MRO service providers, consultants, investors and venture capital firms. Beyond the exhibition floor, AEDEX + AIRPORT 2026 will feature a comprehensive programme of high-level conferences, strategic knowledge sessions and expert-led discussions focusing on defence modernisation, indigenous manufacturing, Airport modernisation , emerging technologies, global supply chains, exports, innovation and international collaboration. Dedicated Buyer-Seller Meets, B2B networking sessions, international pavilions and a Start-up and Innovation Pavilion will facilitate business partnerships, technology transfers and investment opportunities across the defence value chain. The events will provide exhibitors with an opportunity to enhance brand visibility among government decision-makers, defence procurement agencies, armed forces, global buyers and industry leaders while enabling participants to explore joint ventures, technology partnerships, export opportunities and collaborative research initiatives. This apart, it will offer valuable insights into evolving defence procurement policies, indigenisation programmes and government support mechanisms that are shaping India's future aerospace and defence landscape. As India continues to strengthen its position as a trusted global defence manufacturing and technology partner, AEDEX + AIRPORT 2026 is poised to become one of the country's leading international platforms for innovation, strategic collaboration and business development. Bringing together policymakers, industry leaders, defence organisations and technology pioneers from across the world, the events aim to contribute meaningfully to India's vision of becoming a globally competitive hub for aerospace and defence manufacturing. Dr. Abhay A. Pashilkar, Honorary President of SIATI, said the event offers MSMEs, startups and established companies a unique platform to connect, learn and expand their business horizons.
